title: FormaFin: Verifiable Financial Analysis with Solver-Guided Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formally verifying financial analyses generated by large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as financial rules are largely expressed in natural language and rarely have corresponding formal specifications. Training language models to formalize these rules is hindered by the scarcity of labeled data and reliable training signals, while confidential financial data favor small models that run locally. We introduce FormaFin, a framework that trains small open language models to translate financial rules into reusable SMT formulas. FormaFin integrates teacher distillation with reinforcement learning using an SMT solver to compute rewards from numerical thresholds stated in financial rules. We evaluate FormaFin on corporate loan monitoring, in which lenders check borrowers' financial figures against loan agreements. translated_title: FormaFin：基于求解器引导强化学习的可验证金融分析
translated_abstract: 由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的金融分析的形式化验证仍然充满挑战，因为金融规则主要以自然语言表达，很少拥有对应的形式化规范。训练语言模型将这些规则形式化受到标注数据稀缺和可靠训练信号匮乏的阻碍，而机密的金融数据则更青睐可在本地运行的小型模型。我们提出了FormaFin，这是一个训练小型开源语言模型将金融规则转化为可复用SMT公式的框架。FormaFin将教师蒸馏与强化学习相结合，利用SMT求解器从金融规则中陈述的数值阈值计算奖励。我们在企业贷款监控场景上评估FormaFin，在该场景中贷方需要根据贷款协议核查借款人的财务指标。为评估我们的框架，我们构建了一个包含143份贷款协议和2,527个问题的基准测试集……
tldr: FormaFin通过教师蒸馏与SMT求解器引导的强化学习，训练小型开源语言模型将自然语言金融规则转化为可复用的SMT公式，从而实现对LLM生成的金融分析的形式化验证。
en_tdlr: FormaFin trains small open language models to translate natural-language financial rules into reusable SMT formulas through teacher distillation and solver-guided reinforcement learning, enabling formal verification of LLM-generated financial analyses.
